A Regular Coder account reports a three-hour assessment covering aptitude, reasoning, verbal/communication, programming logic, four regular coding questions and three additional Power Coder questions. The technical interview included string reversal and project discussion.

A developer account reports implementing and optimizing Fibonacci code, Java collections, SQL, and willingness to relocate. These differ from the data-science interview areas, so preparation should follow the role.
